findings.claim: BESI H1-26 訂單 €562.6M，年增 116.5%，由光子、混合鍵合、資料中心運算帶動的廣泛成長；Q3-26 營收指引較 Q2 的 €249.9M 增 10-15%
findings.source: Press Release: be Semiconductor Industries N.V. Announces Q2-26 and H1-26 Results
findings.excerpt: Orders of EUR 562.6 million rose 116.5% vs. H1-25 due to broad based growth across end-user markets with strength in photonics, hybrid bonding and datacenter computing applications.

findings.claim: Yole：後段設備營收 2026Q1 季增 6.2%，預估 Q2 再增 3.8%，由 AI、HBM、先進封裝領動，傳統封裝緩步復甦
findings.source: Yole Group Semiconductor Back-end Equipment Market Monitor
findings.excerpt: Back-end equipment revenue increased by 6.2% QoQ from Q4 2025 to Q1 2026 and is projected to increase further by 3.8% QoQ in Q2 2026 as growth is led by AI, HBM and Advanced Packaging while mainstream assembly recovers more gradually.
